name: alert_breaker_state
label: Alert Breaker State
description: Alarm breaker status this feature is designed to support time-based statistical queries and association queries related to alarm-related scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: policy_id
fields.description: Strategy_id. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: event_handler_id
fields.description: Event plugin ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: unique_key
fields.description: The unique identifier for the breaker, generated by the handler using MD5.

fields.name: window_end
fields.description: Current end time of the statistical window. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: open_until
fields.description: Meltdown end time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: last_trigger_time
fields.description: Last trigger time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: skip_count
fields.description: Number of times the circuit breaker is bypassed during the break.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_policy_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the policy_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_window_end
indexes.description: Standard index covering the window_end field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.description: Unique index covering the policy_id, unique_key fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
